title: Jeff Hurd
intro:
Jeff Hurd (Republican Party) is a member of the U.S. House, representing Colorado's 3rd Congressional District. He assumed office on January 3, 2025. His current term ends on January 3, 2027.
Hurd (Republican Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. House to represent Colorado's 3rd Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
